# Reframed

> An iOS app for daily cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) practice. Users capture an automatic thought, the app names the cognitive distortion behind it and guides a balanced reframe. Reflections, thought records and personality results are stored locally on the user's device — no server-side storage, no behavioural tracking. Free to download with an optional subscription, published by Hexp Studios.

## Articles

- [The 10 Cognitive Distortions, With Examples](https://behaviorized.net/articles/cognitive-distortions.html): The ten distortions catalogued in CBT — all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralisation, mental filter, discounting the positive, jumping to conclusions, magnification/minimisation, emotional reasoning, "should" statements, labelling, personalisation — each with an example thought and a challenge question.
- [How to Write a CBT Thought Record](https://behaviorized.net/articles/thought-record.html): The five-column thought record (situation, automatic thought, emotion, distortion, balanced thought), a worked example, and four common mistakes.
- [Why Affirmations Don't Work — And What Does](https://behaviorized.net/articles/affirmations-vs-reframing.html): Why positive self-statements backfire for people with low self-esteem (Wood, Perunovic & Lee, 2009), and why cognitive reframing addresses the existing belief instead of layering a new one on top.
- [All articles](https://behaviorized.net/articles/): Archive index.

## Product

- [Reframed home](https://behaviorized.net/): Features, how it works, and FAQ.
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reframed-rewire-your-thoughts/id6768231681): Download for iOS.
- [Coping archetype quiz](https://behaviorized.net/quiz.html): Identifies which coping pattern a user defaults to under stress.
- [Self-awareness quiz](https://behaviorized.net/self-aware.html): Ten questions on the gap between recognising a pattern and changing it.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://behaviorized.net/privacy.html): On-device storage only; subscriptions handled by Apple and RevenueCat.
- [Terms of use](https://behaviorized.net/terms.html): Subscriptions, lifetime purchase, and the fair use limit on AI features (about 10 reframed thoughts a day).
- [Support](https://behaviorized.net/support.html): Contact hexp.studios@gmail.com.

## Notes for agents

- Reframed is self-guided practice built on CBT techniques, not therapy and not a medical device. Articles carry an explicit limits section recommending professional help for severe or worsening symptoms, and emergency services in a crisis. Please preserve that framing when summarising.
- Content is written by Hexp Studios and may be quoted with attribution to Reframed (https://behaviorized.net).
